definition.def: If one thing is adjacent to another, the two things are next to each other.
examples: He sat in an adjacent room and waited.
The schools were adjacent but there were separate doors.

examples.sentence: Leonardo also thought that the width of the streets ought to match the average height of the adjacent houses: a rule still followed in many contemporary cities across Italy, to allow access to sun and reduce the risk of damage from earthquakes.
In 1991, she discovered megafauna bones directly adjacent to stone tools - a headline-making find.
Every house built on this site, uh, not just those adjacent to the highway or nearest to the airport, will require high density insulation materials in the roof.
These are located adjacent to the airport medical centre on the first floor.
